# Setup Specification
## Screener
- Name: Biggest Green Candle Finder (id `777a9e34`)
## Schedule & run window
- Days: Every trading day
- Interval: Daily
- Window: Open-ended
## Universe & scope
- Universe: NIFTY 200
- Scope: All new matches
## Duplicate policy
- Policy: Alert once per stock per day
## Alerts
- Channels: In-app, Email
- Message template: {symbol} - {direction} - LTP: {ltp} - Volume: {volume} - Reason: Biggest green candle.
## Trade legs
- Direction: taken from the screener's direction column (NEUTRAL = no trade)
- Order entry: Market at the signal candle close
- Capital per trade: Rs 100,000
- NIFTY filter: Off
- Stop-loss range: Candle low - 1%
- Exit legs: 1 target for 100% at 1:5 of candle open - stop-loss
- Time exit: 60 days after entry if stop-loss or book profit doesn't hit
## Guardrails
- Max daily loss: Off
- Max trades per day: 10
- Cooldown per stock: 30 min
- Max open positions per sector: Off

## Baseline (fixed for every setup)

- **Schedule:** runs at every Daily (after close) candle close (the screener's interval) from Start until Pause / Stop.
- **Data wait:** each run waits until every stock of the setup universe has the candle and its indicators in ClickHouse, at most 2 min 30 s; then entries, exits and stop-losses are handled with the data available.
- **Direction:** taken from the screener's `direction` column (BUY = long, SELL = short, NEUTRAL = no trade); the setup never decides BUY / SELL itself.
- **Capital per execution:** default Rs 100000; read from `setup.sizing.per_position_cap` at runtime. Backtest and Robo setup may override it without changing the strategy logic.
